title: 2025 Omaha Brunch Q&A
description:
We held our first Omaha Brunch in 1991, and there were six close friends in attendance. In 2025, we had over 2,600 people attend. The event has become an opportunity for investors, associates, and friends to gather, exchange ideas, and participate in a Q&A with Markel Group leaders.

Learn more at: www.mklreunion.com/omaha
